queue.title: Add verify script + record baseline metrics
queue.details: Add `verify` npm script (build then vitest run). Record baseline in log.md: test count, suite runtime, tsc runtime, scoped coverage numbers (npm run test:coverage). No src changes.

queue.title: Tooling baseline: ESLint (typescript-eslint strict+stylistic) + Prettier
queue.details: Flat eslint config + prettier, npm run lint / lint:fix / format. Apply auto-fixes and a one-time prettier format as a PURE formatting commit (no logic). Document remaining (non-auto-fixable) violations per file in refactor/lint-debt.md as input for Phase 2 items. Style decisions to codify: no getX()/setX() Java accessors (prefer properties/accessors), prefer for..of & array methods, template literals, ===, no var, prefer const, explicit return types on exported API. ALSO (T1 verifier finding): tests are not typechecked by the build (tsconfig excludes *.test.ts) — close that hole, e.g. tsconfig.tests.json + extend the verify script with a no-emit typecheck over tests/, so type breakage in adapted tests surfaces at the gate, not just as vitest runtime failures.

queue.title: Excise out-of-scope modules
queue.details: Scope = MEI / MSM+MPM => MIDI (see vitest.config.ts coverage include list). Remove via `git rm`: src/mei/Mei2MusicXmlConverter.ts, src/musicxml/**, src/audio/**, src/midi/Midi2MsmConverter.ts, src/supplementary/ColorCoding.ts IF unreferenced by in-scope code, and any other module unreachable from the in-scope surface (check imports transitively; also prune index.ts/Meico.ts exports and any dead tests for removed modules). Keep Midi playback-free: strip audio/playback methods from Midi.ts only if fully out of the dependency cone of MIDI file generation. Verify green.

queue.title: Local idioms: supplementary/ (KeyValue, RandomNumberProvider)
queue.details: Idiomatic TS within same public behavior. KeyValue likely becomes a readonly tuple or minimal class kept for API compat (full replacement is T16's call). RandomNumberProvider: field initializers, private #/private, remove Java-isms. Unit tests adapted.

queue.title: Local idioms: xml/XomTypes.ts
queue.details: Internal cleanup only — the XOM-emulation API surface stays (it is load-bearing for serialization equivalence). Idiomatic internals, doc comment explaining the layer's purpose and byte-compat constraints. Deeper redesign is T17.

queue.title: Local idioms: mpm styles + defs
queue.details: src/mpm/elements/styles/** — getters/setters to accessors/properties, constructor patterns, static factory cleanup, union types over pseudo-enums, remove dead Java idioms. Update unit tests mechanically.

queue.title: Local idioms: mpm maps + data classes
queue.details: src/mpm/elements/maps/** including data/. Same idiom checklist. Careful: rendering math must stay bit-identical; no reordering of floating-point operations.

queue.title: Local idioms: mpm core (Mpm, Performance, Header, metadata)
queue.details: Same checklist. Performance.perform flow untouched semantically (pipeline redesign is T19).

queue.title: Local idioms: msm/ cluster
queue.details: Msm, AbstractMsm, Goto, etc. Same checklist.

queue.title: Local idioms: mei/ cluster (Mei, Helper, Mei2MsmMpmConverter)
queue.details: Local idioms only — no structural break-up yet (that is T14/T15). These are the biggest files; keep diffs reviewable by splitting into ≤3 sub-rounds if needed (still one commit).

queue.title: Local idioms: midi/ cluster
queue.details: Midi, MidiTypes, EventMaker, InstrumentsDictionary. InstrumentsDictionary's big data tables may become const data structures. Byte-identical MIDI output required (suite proves it).

queue.title: Architecture design doc
queue.details: Architect agent produces refactor/ARCHITECTURE.md: target module map, public API design (clean facade for MEI->MSM+MPM->MIDI), layering rules, null-vs-undefined policy, class-vs-function policy, error handling policy, what stays class-based for parity reasons, AND the immutability policy per the charter's 'immutable-friendly' section (where mutation is confined, what is readonly, immutable public API contract). Verifier reviews it for equivalence risk. No code changes.

queue.title: Public facade + index exports
queue.details: Implement the ARCHITECTURE.md facade (e.g. parseMei/convertToMsmMpm/perform/renderMidi) as additive API; index.ts exports curated; old entry points kept working. Integration tests may switch to facade only mechanically. ACCEPTANCE (charter, facade-plain-data bullet): facade outputs are plain JSON-serializable/structured-clone-safe data — survives postMessage, supports referential-equality memoization; XomTypes/XML types never appear in facade signatures.

queue.title: Split mei/Helper.ts into focused modules
queue.details: Static-utility god class into cohesive modules per ARCHITECTURE.md. Pure moves + renames; call sites updated; no logic edits.

queue.title: Restructure Mei2MsmMpmConverter
queue.details: Element-dispatch architecture (handler map per MEI element) per ARCHITECTURE.md, replacing the Java-style switch/instanceof cascades. Highest-risk item: sub-round per element group, verify after each.

queue.title: Model layer: composition & types (msm/mpm)
queue.details: Per ARCHITECTURE.md: reduce inheritance depth, KeyValue->tuples if decided, typed attribute access helpers, GenericMap/GenericStyle generics cleaned, immutable-friendly model surface (readonly properties, no input mutation outside declared boundaries). Behavior-identical.

queue.title: XML layer isolation
queue.details: XomTypes behind a slim internal interface with a clean TS API; serialization byte-compat proven by full suite. Rename to reflect role (e.g. src/xml/dom.ts). Only if ARCHITECTURE.md judges the risk worth it; otherwise document and close.

queue.title: Eliminate circular imports + enforce
queue.details: Fix the Mpm/GenericStyle deep-import hazard and all other cycles (map with madge or eslint import/no-cycle); add lint enforcement so they cannot return.

queue.title: Performance rendering pipeline cleanup
queue.details: Performance.perform + map-rendering flow into clearly composed stages per ARCHITECTURE.md. Floating-point operation order must not change. Ornamentation ms-domain rendering (Java OrnamentationMap.java:477-509 parity) is especially sensitive.

queue.title: MIDI generation layer cleanup
queue.details: EventMaker/Midi restructure per ARCHITECTURE.md; event ordering and byte layout must stay identical (midi-byte-equivalence suite proves it).

queue.title: Dead-code sweep + coverage audit
queue.details: Remove now-dead code (ts-prune or knip), re-run scoped coverage, must be >= baseline floor. Update vitest.config.ts include list if module paths moved (mechanical only).

queue.title: Package hardening + docs
queue.details: package.json exports map, sideEffects, engines, declaration maps; README with API examples and the Java-parity story; document deliberate bug-for-bug parity list. ALSO: rename package to `espressivo` (npm name `meico` is taken; user adopted the new name — update package.json name + any self-references in README/docs).

queue.title: Final adversarial audit
queue.details: Fresh audit agent: full-diff review vs baseline commit for any semantic drift; perf smoke (suite runtime + a large-fixture render) vs baseline numbers from T1; verify all invariants held (fixtures untouched: git log on tests/integration/fixtures must be empty after baseline). Final report to user.
